section_summary.extract_value: Abstract reports a single study (Study X) of 249 college women testing a model in which body appreciation mediates links from caregiver eating messages, attachment anxiety, and perfectionism to intuitive eating. Body appreciation positively predicted intuitive eating but not depressive symptoms, and several interpersonal/intrapersonal predictors inversely predicted body appreciation. The abstract provides no information on country, age, racial composition, BMI, measurement instruments for body appreciation, or survey method.
